channel.description: Latest articles from Ink Free News (inkfreenews.com)

item.title: ‘Success Sequence’ Bill Requiring Marriage-Before-Children Instruction Advances From Indiana Senate
item.description: An education proposal to expand Indiana’s required “good citizenship” instruction to include high school completion, full-time employment and marriage passed the Senate on Thursday, Jan. 29 but drew opposition from Democrats.

item.title: Kiley reappointed to Indiana Natural Resources Foundation Board
item.description: Matthew Kiley, St. Joseph County and Lake Wawasee, was among the new appointments to various state boards and commissions by Gov. Mike Braun Friday, Jan. 30.

item.title: Consistent Donations Provide Critical Blood Products For Patients
item.description: Winter storms and seasonal illnesses have caused a critical need for blood donations, which hospitals rely on to treat their patients.

item.title: CASA Gave Thanks To Volunteers At Annual Meeting
item.description: CASA of Kosciusko County gave thanks to all of its volunteers that help the children in Kosciusko County feel safe.

item.title: State Tax Cut For Overtime And Tips Clears Senate
item.description: A one-year state income tax break on overtime and tips for Hoosier workers has cleared the Indiana Senate as lawmakers pick and choose among the federal tax cuts that Pres. Donald Trump pushed through Congress last summer.

item.title: Latest filings for May primary elections
item.description: A fourth person has filed for the Syracuse Town Council At-Large seat.

item.title: Rep. Yakym Honors Memorial MedFlight for 20 Years of Lifesaving Service
item.description: Congressman Rudy Yakym presented a Congressional Record to Memorial MedFlight Friday, Jan. 30, in recognition of its 20th anniversary of providing lifesaving air medical services to communities across northern Indiana and southwestern Michigan.

item.title: UPDATE: Man Flown To Warsaw Hospital After Tractor Hit By Train
item.description: A man was flown to a Warsaw hospital for injuries he sustained after his tractor was hit by a train near Claypool on Thursday afternoon.

item.title: Indiana National Guard ‘Military Police’ Bill Passes House
item.description: Following 90 minutes of intense debate, a bill empowering Indiana’s governor to deploy a “military police force” of Indiana National Guard members throughout the state advanced Wednesday, Jan. 28 from the House on a 67-29 vote. It now heads to the Senate.

item.title: Eight Tippecanoe Valley Graduates Recognized at Distinguished Alumni Dinner
item.description: Eight Tippecanoe Valley Community School graduates were recognized at the Tippecanoe Valley Distinguished Alumni Dinner on Thursday, Jan. 29.
